code='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    # Grid cells are separated by full 8-valued lines; seed colors propagate\n    # across their entire cell row or column. Intersections combine to 6.\n    row_divs = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[r])]\n    col_divs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]\n    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in row_divs]\n    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in col_divs]\n    row_ends = row_divs + [h]\n    col_ends = col_divs + [w]\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for ri, (rs, re) in enumerate(zip(row_starts, row_ends)):\n        for ci, (cs, ce) in enumerate(zip(col_starts, col_ends)):\n            colors = {v for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cs, ce) if (v := grid[r][c]) in (2, 3)}\n            if not colors: continue\n            # Any 3-seed in this cell-row colors every cell in the row;\n            # any 2-seed in this cell-column colors every cell in the column.\n            row_has3 = any(3 in {grid[r][c] for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cs, ce)} for _ in [0])\n            col_has2 = any(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cs, ce))\n            # Determine global activation from seed locations, per bands.\n    active3rows = set(); active2cols = set()\n    for ri, (rs,re) in enumerate(zip(row_starts,row_ends)):\n        if any(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(rs,re) for c in range(w) if c not in col_divs): active3rows.add(ri)\n    for ci, (cs,ce) in enumerate(zip(col_starts,col_ends)):\n        if any(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h) if r not in row_divs for c in range(cs,ce)): active2cols.add(ci)\n    for ri,(rs,re) in enumerate(zip(row_starts,row_ends)):\n        for ci,(cs,ce) in enumerate(zip(col_starts,col_ends)):\n            color = 6 if ri in active3rows and ci in active2cols else 3 if ri in active3rows else 2 if ci in active2cols else 0\n            if color:\n                for r in range(rs,re):\n                    for c in range(cs,ce): out[r][c] = color\n    return out\n'''
